note: MOD_PLAN F15 (AdrianBM96/Strata3060 STRATA_FETCH_ADMIT, claimed +5.1/+7.0/+5.1% decode on an RTX 3060), RTX 3060 only; the CUDA build is the plain dev/batch-1 one (no new kernel: this tree already holds the engine's own version of the idea as STRATA_ADAPT_FETCH, and STRATA_FETCH_ADMIT=1 is its alias). Run with --tier screen. READ THE ARMS AGAINST 'sync', NOT AGAINST THE PRESET: the preset runs --adapt-async 1 and STRATA_ADAPT_FETCH is OFF under --adapt-async (the startup log says 'STRATA_ADAPT_FETCH is off (--adapt-async)'), so every fetch arm sets --adapt-async 0 (not null: with no flag the engine's own async chooser may switch the tier back on). sync = the control for the fetch arms (blocking tier, the sm_86 table's ADAPT_NOWAIT=1 / ADAPT_LAG=2 stay on); async-preset = the preset as shipped (how much the blocking tier costs by itself: if the fetch arms do not beat async-preset the port is not worth the loss of the async tier); admit = STRATA_FETCH_ADMIT=1 (= STRATA_ADAPT_FETCH=1: the PCIe share also admits, beside the tier's own copies); admit-fetch2 = STRATA_ADAPT_FETCH=2 (the tier's own copies off in a layer where an admission ran; +10.2% vs +5.0% for =1 on a PRO 5000 upstream); admit-fetch1-m2 = =1 with a stricter margin (2 instead of 0.5: fewer, surer admissions, closer to the fork's 'few copies' finding); sync-nowait0 / admit-nowait0 = the same pair with the ADAPT_NOWAIT/LAG table switched off, to see whether the interaction the fork refused to run with matters (here it is handled: with the tier lagging the engine forces evict_sync and uploads the residency table before each window). No --pcie-frac flag anywhere = the engine's auto share (a literal '--pcie-frac auto' is NOT accepted: atof gives 0, which is --pcie-frac 0, the share off, where every fetch arm is inert). Before trusting an arm check the server log: the 'STRATA_ADAPT_FETCH=1: the PCIe share takes ...' line must be there, and the per-request line 'strata serve: STRATA_ADAPT_FETCH: N experts kept in the VRAM cache from the PCIe share since the start' must show N growing (N = 0 or no line: the share never admitted, treat the arm as a base run; `strata generate` prints 'fetch admission' at the end); an arm whose log says 'is off (...)' is a base run. Admission changes later placement (GPU instead of CPU rounding), so the text may differ from sync: that is not a bug, it goes through token forcing (--path decode) and the task gate, as the fork's KL 0.002 and upstream's +0.19 pt mismatch say. abtest.py is HIP-first: check on the 3060 box that a server starts through it and CUDA libraries resolve before trusting a batch (see 16-3060-env.json). The 7900 XT preset runs --pcie-frac 0: do not run this spec there.
